papers.title: DeepLabV3+ for Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract: DeepLabV3+ extends DeepLabV3 by adding a simple yet effective decoder module to refine segmentation results.

papers.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: U-Net is a convolutional network architecture for fast and precise segmentation of biomedical images.

papers.title: Attention U-Net: Learning Where to Look for the Pancreas
papers.abstract: Attention U-Net introduces attention gates that focus on target structures of varying shapes and sizes.

papers.title: nnU-Net: Self-adapting Framework for U-Net-Based Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: nnU-Net automatically configures itself for any new medical segmentation task.

papers.title: TransUNet: Transformers Make Strong Encoders for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: TransUNet hybridizes transformers and U-Net for medical image segmentation.

papers.title: Swin-Unet: Unet-like Pure Transformer for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: Swin-Unet is a pure transformer-based U-Net architecture for medical image segmentation.

papers.title: UNETR: Transformers for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: UNETR utilizes a transformer as the encoder for 3D medical image segmentation.

papers.title: MedSAM: Segment Anything in Medical Images
papers.abstract: MedSAM adapts the Segment Anything Model to medical images.

papers.title: SAMed: Segment Anything Model for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: SAMed fine-tunes SAM for medical image segmentation with adapter modules.

papers.title: EfficientMedSAM: Accelerated Medical SAM with Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract: EfficientMedSAM accelerates MedSAM through knowledge distillation for practical clinical use.
